```{python}
#| echo: false
import graphviz
from IPython.display import Image as IPImage, display

from dih_models.plotting.graphviz_helper import setup_graphviz_style, render_graphviz_with_watermark

# Create diagram

dot = graphviz.Digraph(comment='Wishocracy Architecture', format='png')
dot.attr(rankdir='TB', size='8,10', nodesep='0.8', ranksep='0.5')

# Apply design guide styling

setup_graphviz_style(dot)

# -- LAYER 1: DEMOCRATIC VALUES --

with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_layer1') as c1:
    c1.attr(label='LAYER 1: DEMOCRATIC VALUES (What we want)', style='dashed', color='black')
    c1.node('Citizens', 'Citizens\n(All Stakeholders)', shape='ellipse')
    c1.node('RAPPA', 'RAPPA Mechanism\n(Preference Aggregation)', shape='box', penwidth='2')
    c1.node('Priorities', 'Societal Priorities\n(Weighted Outcomes)', shape='note')
    
    c1.edge('Citizens', 'RAPPA', label=' Input (Pairs)')
    c1.edge('RAPPA', 'Priorities', label=' Output (Weights)')

# -- INTERFACE --

with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_interface') as ci:
    ci.attr(label='', penwidth='0') # Invisible container for alignment
    ci.node('Mandate', label='<<B>FUNDED MANDATE</B><BR/><B>(Budget + Goals)</B>>', shape='doubleoctagon', style='filled', fillcolor='black', fontcolor='white')

# -- LAYER 2: TECHNOCRATIC EXECUTION --

with dot.subgraph(name='cluster_layer2') as c2:
    c2.attr(label='LAYER 2: TECHNOCRATIC EXECUTION (How we get it)', style='dashed', color='black')
    c2.node('GenieDAOs', 'GenieDAOs\n(Expert Teams)', shape='box')
    c2.node('Proposals', 'Implementation Proposals\n(Strategies)', shape='box', style='dashed')
    c2.node('Selection', 'Cost-Effectiveness\nReview', shape='diamond')
    c2.node('Action', 'Real-World Action\n(Solutions)', shape='box', penwidth='2')
    
    c2.edge('GenieDAOs', 'Proposals', label=' Design')
    c2.edge('Proposals', 'Selection', label=' Evaluate')
    c2.edge('Selection', 'Action', label=' Fund')

# -- CONNECT LAYERS --

dot.edge('Priorities', 'Mandate', label=' Defined By')
dot.edge('Mandate', 'GenieDAOs', label=' Bounties For')

# Render

png_path = render_graphviz_with_watermark(dot, 'wishocracy-architecture-diagram')
display(IPImage(str(png_path)))
```
